rationale: With only 9 minutes to close, the stock is showing indecisive 1-minute price action (oscillating between ~116.67 and 117.36) with a wide 78 bps bid-ask spread that would immediately consume a significant portion of any potential gain. The stock has already gapped up 2.68% on a Q3 earnings beat reported 550 minutes ago, meaning the news catalyst is largely priced in, and the position in the upper 82% of today's range with price slightly below the 9-EMA suggests momentum is fading rather than accelerating. The combination of spread cost, end-of-day liquidation risk, and lack of a clear directional catalyst makes this an unfavorable risk/reward setup.
